answer: Reputation-bridge delay escrow. Each new identity must bridge its first payments through a shared escrow that holds funds for a randomized glacier-slow clearing window before release. Clones earn nothing during the delay while paying escrow fees, so their expected yield turns hollow. Honest agents amortize the wait across steady volume; an attacker's marginal clone is strictly negative-EV because every duplicate pays the fee and idle holding cost without recovering them.
